purpose: Resolve one representative FY2024 TWD/USD duplication for each of TSM, UMC, and ASX from its original SEC 20-F, without selecting a factor or using returns.
source_identity: SEC original primary 20-F HTML in the accession indexed by EDGAR
checks: Bind exact downloaded bytes to accession, size, and SHA-256.
Inspect the original statement denomination and any convenience translation note for FY2024.
Inspect annual revenue duration and inventory instant/context only as a source-semantic lead; do not infer historic PIT qualification from a web download.
Keep historical issuer-security identity and first-public version status unknown unless the same original filing expressly resolves it.
decision_rule: Mark only the source semantics demonstrated by these three original filings; do not generalize FY2024 to other years, alter the previous source qualification, calculate factor values, or choose units by market outcomes.
